The most followed person and man is Portuguese footballer [[Cristiano Ronaldo]] and the most followed woman is American singer-actress [[Selena Gomez]]. {{Dynamic list}} File:Cristiano Ronaldo Portugal.jpg|[[Cristiano Ronaldo]] is the most-followed individual, man, sportsperson and European on Instagram, with over 600 million followers. File:Lionel Messi 20180626.jpg|[[Lionel Messi]] is the most-followed South American on Instagram, with over 487 million followers. File:191125 Selena Gomez at the 2019 American Music Awards.png|[[Selena Gomez]] is the most-followed woman, actor, musician and North American on Instagram, with over 429 million followers. File:Virat Kohli with AudiQ7.png|[[Virat Kohli]] is the most-followed Asian on Instagram, with over 259 million followers.
